main_body: Tall wall cabinet: a 3x4 grid of drawer/compartment fronts in a red-brown frame, with a cream header band on top and dark feet
top_band: cream/tan band at rows ~2-4 (orange rim at row 1) with a few yellow dots; it reads as a header or label strip rather than a horizontal surface
evidence: Reading down the middle column: orange rim (row 1), cream band (rows 2-4), dark red strip (rows 5-6), then the drawer grid (rows 7-27) and a dark red base. The cream band is only about 3 rows, set against a 30-row object, and has yellow marks on it, so it looks like a face-on signboard. The body is a flat grid of drawer fronts with no foreshortened top surface and no distinct front-edge highlight line. The red strip below the band only partly works as an eave shadow. It is a front elevation with a hat, not a 3/4 object.

style.evidence: The ramps are shallow, with about 4 steps (cream, tan, mid-brown, dark red, plus yellow accents). The outline is a tinted dark red-brown, which is fine. The drawer fronts repeat the same tiny pattern 12 times with no grain or per-piece variation. The red frame and the cream band are large, mostly flat fills. Tiles carry only about 3-5 colours, well below the stall and well references, which have varied texture, highlights and speckle.
